_README: Spend/rate limits for agent calls (P3). Loaded by src/agents/limits.js, enforced by src/agents/spendGuard.js BEFORE every model call. Defaults are deliberately closed: only the free mock model has a price, the daily cap is 0 USD and mode 'real' is refused, so no real call can happen. The daily cap resets at 00:00 UTC. Change only via a reviewed PR.

_PRODUCT_OWNER_SETS_IN_LOT3.mode: 'real' (only after the Lot 3 approval; the loader refuses it until the code allows it)
_PRODUCT_OWNER_SETS_IN_LOT3.daily_spend_cap_usd: your hard daily ceiling across both providers, e.g. 2.00
_PRODUCT_OWNER_SETS_IN_LOT3.per_call_max_usd: ceiling for a single call, e.g. 0.25
_PRODUCT_OWNER_SETS_IN_LOT3.pricing_usd_per_mtok: add one entry per real model actually used: "openai/<model>": { input, output } at the provider's current list prices, and "anthropic/claude-code-headless": { reported_cost: true } (Claude Code reports total_cost_usd); a model without an entry is refused
_PRODUCT_OWNER_SETS_IN_LOT3.transport: keep max_retries small (each retry can cost); max_retry_after_s caps how long a 429 may make us wait
_PRODUCT_OWNER_SETS_IN_LOT3.claude_code: max_turns and the exact allowed_tools list for the worker
